chunks: Abu Ayyub narrated from Abu 'Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, one of them combines and drives the sacrificial offering, so I leave him as a punishment for what he has done.

key_terms.بِمَا: For what; indicating the reason for the consequence.
key_terms.صَنَعَ: He did; referring to the act the person committed.
key_terms.يَسُوقُ: He drives; here, he brings along or drives the sacrificial offering.
key_terms.يَقْرِنُ: He combines; here, it refers to performing qirān in the context of hajj.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about one who combines rites and drives the sacrificial offering in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a ruling connected to the forms of hajj and the act of combining rites while driving the sacrificial animal. The Imam عليه السلام states that such a person is left to the consequence of his own action as a form of penalty for what he has done.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2548 - Abu Ayyub narrated from Abu ‘Abdullah (as), who said:
"Indeed, one of them combines (qarana) and drives (hady), and so I leave him as a consequence (punishment) for what he has done."
